commit_strategy_draft.description: Publish the player's draft of one strategy. Name the draftVersion and, as expectedRevision, the committedRevision get_strategy_draft returned (null for a strategy not created yet): the commit publishes exactly that draft over exactly that revision, through the same commit the strategy editor's Save runs, and clears the axes it published from the draft. Committed edits take effect on every agent bound to the strategy immediately, and the commit closes no position. An open position never gates or refuses the commit: it keeps the exit rules, exit policy and levels it opened with, so those edits reach only positions opened after the commit. Commit only after the player has seen the diff and the impact and explicitly confirmed. Refused with DRAFT_VERSION_MOVED when the draft changed after your read and CONFLICT when the strategy did — read again and show the player what it now holds — and with the validation error the diagnostics named when the draft cannot be committed — stage a fix. Each such refusal carries nextAct: get_draft or stage. A retry of the same draftVersion returns the first commit's receipt.

expectedRevision.description: The `committedRevision` get_strategy_draft returned: null for a strategy not created yet.

discard_strategy_draft.description: Destroy the player's draft of one strategy at the draftVersion get_strategy_draft returned. It is the PLAYER's decision, never your judgement that a draft looks stale: tell them when it was last written and by which surface, and discard only on their word. It touches no strategy, no revision and no other draft, and it cannot be undone. Refused with DRAFT_VERSION_MOVED when the draft changed after your read, so a write that landed since is never destroyed.

get_strategy_draft.description: Read the player's draft of one strategy with everything a commit needs: the draft (null when the player holds none), its draftVersion (0 when there is none), the committedRevision it would be published over (null for a strategy not created yet), a diff of every drafted axis against the live strategy with the fields that differ, the diagnostics the commit would refuse or observe, and the impact of committing it. Read this before staging and again before committing: another of the player's surfaces can change the draft while you work. Show the player the diff and the impact, and commit only on their explicit word.

list_strategy_drafts.description: Answer 'what am I part-way through?' for strategys: one page of the player's drafts, newest first, each with its strategy (or none yet, for a create draft), when it was last touched, which surface touched it and whether its base revision has moved. Call this before starting a new strategy and offer to continue a draft rather than starting a second one beside it. Paginate with the returned cursor.

preview_strategy_report.description: The many-coins-in-one-call market read: one table per report module with COINS AS ROWS, the schema preamble emitted once rather than per coin. Renders a bounded live-market preview of `source` over a required bounded `coinSelection`: either the report's own fields ({"kind":"FIELDS", timeframe, sections, conditions?, marketReadText?, marketReadLensTicker?}) or the player's strategy draft by reference ({"kind":"DRAFT", strategyId, draftVersion} at the draftVersion get_strategy_draft returned, composed exactly as its commit would compose it — a moved draft is refused with DRAFT_VERSION_MOVED). It returns server-owned budget usage — including the estimated-token budget as used/cap over the served payload — without saving or mutating strategy state. Callable without the authoring vocabulary: a whole platform module is {"kind":"platform","sectionKey":"includeRsi"} (list them with list_strategy_categories), and {"mode":"ranked","limit":N} selects a cohort without naming coins. Prefer this over looping a per-coin tool. The result describes the report you composed, not the platform catalog: `conditionColumns` carries the sections this report renders, while vocabulary that depends on no draft — a report-level scalar's gloss, operators and label vocabulary — is served by list_strategy_vocabulary and referenced here by `vocabularyDigest`, so resolve it once and cache it against that string. The preview execution limits (result byte cap, deadline) are served by discovery, not by this result.

items.description: Coin symbol — ticker or exchange symbol, e.g. "BTC", "kPEPE", "xyz:BRENTOIL" (case-insensitive)

marketReadLensTicker.description: Coin symbol — ticker or exchange symbol, e.g. "BTC", "kPEPE", "xyz:BRENTOIL" (case-insensitive)

benchmarkTicker.description: Coin symbol — ticker or exchange symbol, e.g. "BTC", "kPEPE", "xyz:BRENTOIL" (case-insensitive)

stage_strategy_draft.description: Write a proposed change into the player's draft of one strategy, so it lands in their strategy editor as an attributed unsaved change. This does NOT commit: nothing reaches the live strategy until commit_strategy_draft. Read the draft with get_strategy_draft first, propose against what it shows, and name the draftVersion that read returned (0 when there was no draft). Omit strategyId to open a NEW create draft for a strategy that does not exist yet; the response carries the id minted for it, which every later call names. Axes: IDENTITY — { name, description, tagline }; the name is trimmed, and a new strategy requires it; TIMEFRAME_PROFILE — { timeframe }, the main candle; a new strategy requires it; REPORT — { sections }, the ordered report; a new strategy without it starts from the platform's starting report; MARKET_READ — { marketReadText }; CONDITIONS — { conditions }, each with its verdict, hold and exit flag; ENTRY — { entry }: { trigger: "ON_CANDLE_CLOSE" } alone, or a level trigger with levelOffsetAtrMultiple and validForBars; SETUP_GATES — { minAggregateScore, minRequiredCount, minAtrPct }; TRADE_LEVEL_POLICY — { minStopLossAtrMultiple, maxStopLossAtrMultiple, minRiskRewardRatio }; POSITION_MANAGEMENT — all thirteen exit-policy fields; SIGNAL_RULES — { rules }, complete { signalId, allocation, required, params } rows. Each axis you send is written WHOLE, except SIGNAL_RULES, whose rows replace the drafted rows for the same signalId and keep every other one; axes you omit keep their values. The axes one call sends may serialise to at most 256,000 UTF-8 bytes; a larger stage is refused with VALIDATION_ERROR on axes, and nothing is written. Values are checked for structure here and judged in whole by the diagnostics this call returns — the refusals the commit would raise, and observations that never refuse — so read them and stage again until there are no errors. Refused with DRAFT_AXIS_CONTESTED, naming the axes, when the player's own hand changed one of them after the version you name, and with DRAFT_VERSION_MOVED when that version is one the draft never reached — read from a draft since committed or discarded: read again and propose against what the player now has.

axes.description: The proposed axes, each WHOLE except SIGNAL_RULES, whose rules replace the drafted rules for the same signals and keep every other one. Axes you omit keep the values the draft has.

anyOf.description: Coin symbol — ticker or exchange symbol, e.g. "BTC", "kPEPE", "xyz:BRENTOIL" (case-insensitive)

benchmarkTicker.description: Coin symbol — ticker or exchange symbol, e.g. "BTC", "kPEPE", "xyz:BRENTOIL" (case-insensitive)

draftVersion.description: The draft version this proposal was made against: the `draftVersion` get_strategy_draft returned, or 0 when it found no draft (and for a new create draft).

strategyId.description: The strategy whose draft to stage into. Omit it to open a NEW create draft for a strategy that does not exist yet; the response carries the id minted for it, which every later call names.
